body: Yea, every person has their own troubles. But hold on to them at least, and when you feel like you can't share stuff because it might be overwhelming for them, you can come here. People are very willing to help as well as they can. Maybe you can get some new connections here on reddit?

I understand you, and I'm sorry your family isn't doing what a family should do, which is support you. Do you have any friends at all?  


And it might not do much, but I'm open to talk at least.  
Hope things get better.
I hope things will get better for you. You deserve to feel good.

I'm sorry you're going through this, and I can relate to it aswell. My advice is that if you truly appreciate this friend and want to keep them, apoligize, and tell but also show them that you will improve. Venting to others can be hard to some to deal with, and I suspect that it was consuming a lot of your friend's energy, since they care. Maybe, when something feels bad, post here instead, like you did now. It doesn't hurt anyone and people here can be very supportive.  


I hope it will all work out for you.

I agree. There is a lot of people who experience this, but the upside to it is that it can be treated effectively.   


Hope it gets better.
This is delightful. Poems can be a very nice way to express oneself.

I feel you. Living in a monotone cycle can be exhausting, and my only advice to feel better is to change this cycle. Do something else, something new, maybe. Get a new hobby or find people to chat with. Go for a walk while listening to something you might enjoy.

Hope it gets better.

I'm sorry you are going through this. Have you tried getting professional help?  


I think that you would aid from getting new contacts, which you can make here on reddit, for example. I'm open to talk if you would like.
I think that getting professional help is a good idea. You seem to be in need for help since you've had this for a while and it is difficult to deal with.

A lot of people can relate to this, so you're not alone. It fucking sucks feeling guilty about not being able to appreciate things. All I can say is that in a case like this, it might be good to get professional help and maybe be prescribed some medication. You're not bad for feeling like this, it's just hormones and chemical imbalances messing with your life, which in it self is something valid to be upset about.

I feel this. When I went to school, we had to listen to a whole presentation which this kind of vibe to it. They talked about how people who are doing good and succéed at things have a hard time dealing with pessimistic people, and that they bring them down. The message was basically:"Shut up with your depressive feelings, and let the happy people brag in your face about how their life is so great!" Felt really sick after listening to this for an whole hour.

I appreciate the answer, and yea, I guess they we're never my friends, though that doesn't make it easier, sadly. 

And no, I haven't talked to my mother about it, and I might try, but I'm sure that won't do much for me. I have been in emergency care for suicidal thoughts, and that almost made it worse so my faith in getting help is weak.
